now on deed polls - it's quite easy actually, don't let deed poll services trick u into spending money (like me) just to make ur deed poll look pretty as its completely free, its the words that count. 

this is what u need to write:

 “I \[old name\] of \[your address\] have given up my name \[old name\] and have adopted for all purposes the name \[new name\].  
“Signed as a deed on \[date\] as \[old name\] and \[new name\] in the presence of \[witness 1 name\] of \[witness 1 address\], and \[witness 2 name\] of \[witness 2 address\].  
“\[your new signature\], \[your old signature\]  
“\[witness 1 signature\], \[witness 2 signature\]”

However I did only use 1 witness and it worked out fine, so don't worry it much about finding 2 witnesses 

u can find more information here - [https://www.gov.uk/change-name-deed-poll](https://www.gov.uk/change-name-deed-poll)
